findings.whyThisMatters: A leftover join is a custody document: its basedOn block is where a coordinator reads what each input's standing actually is. Here the reader is told a predecessor specification is merely un-ACCEPTED with its review possibly unfinished, when in fact that review completed and rejected it, and the resulting finding is the reason the v2 specification exists at all. That understates an adverse verdict in the one entry where the artifact departs from its own disclosure convention, in the chain that supports OBL-G31-HARNESS-SPEC's leftoverDesign false.
